literature_notes: Three ledger lines were evaluated. L1 and L2 report a full-length LRRC8C-V5 knock-in mouse but never state the residue or junction at which the V5 tag is inserted. Critically, LRRC8C has no extracellular terminus: the N-terminus (residues 1–25) and C-terminus (residues 340–803) are both intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks, so topology_derived reasoning cannot rescue a surface-site assignment. L3 reports an insertion C-terminally to Q14 of full-length LRRC8C; residue 14 lies within the intracellular N-terminal span (1–25) and the insertion abolished channel activity, making it both intracellular and function-abrogating. No ledger line grounds an extracellular surface tag site for LRRC8C.

literature_other_positions.note: Insertion of a six-residue flexible fragment C-terminally to Q14 (intracellular N-terminal region, residues 1–25) abolished LRRC8A/C channel activity, though the construct still trafficked to the plasma membrane.
